statement: It would be interesting to improve presented bounds to determine the true half-duplex complexity of these functions. We propose the following list of open problems. 1. Prove better upper and lower bounds for the half-duplex models with silence and zero. 2. Is there any α < 1 such that for any f : {0, 1}n × {0, 1}n → {0, 1}, D0hd (f ) ≤ αn + o(n)? 3. Is there any f : {0, 1}n × {0, 1}n → {0, 1}, such that at the same time D(f ) ≥ n − o(n) and Dahd (f ) ≤ αn + o(n) for some α < 1.
